title: Where a New Concept Must Enter: Entry Point Gates Cross-Task Usability in Unified Multimodal Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.17564v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) are motivated by the hope that understanding and generation reinforce each other but controlled ablations repeatedly find that adding a generation objective leaves understanding flat. Joint-training studies cannot settle the disagreement: with overlapping supervision, a gain cannot be attributed to the architecture rather than the data. To further investigate the relationship between the two directions in UMMs, we separate them by construction. A novel visual entity, a rendered 3D asset paired with a pseudo-word screened for absence from the frozen model's behavior, is bound through exactly one task direction, and the untrained direction is then measured. We find that the channel is real in both directions, but the directions differ in kind: generation training installs a name the model can only match among candidates; understanding training installs one it can also produce. translated_title: 新概念必须进入之处：统一多模态模型中入口门控的跨任务可用性
translated_abstract: 统一多模态模型（UMMs）的动机在于希望理解和生成能够相互增强，但受控消融实验反复发现，添加生成目标后理解性能并未提升。联合训练研究无法解决这一分歧：在监督重叠的情况下，性能提升无法归因于架构而非数据。为了进一步探究UMMs中这两个方向之间的关系，我们通过构造将它们分离。我们引入一种新颖的视觉实体——一个渲染的3D资产，配以一个经过筛选确保在冻结模型行为中不存在的伪词，并通过恰好一个任务方向进行绑定，然后测量未训练的方向。我们发现该通道在两个方向上都真实存在，但方向在性质上有所不同：生成训练安装了一个模型只能在候选者中匹配的名称；而理解训练安装了一个模型也能生成的名称。决定跨任务可用性的关键因素在于此。
tldr: 本文通过构造分离统一多模态模型中的理解与生成方向，发现两者通道均真实存在但性质不同，生成训练仅支持候选匹配，而理解训练支持生成，这一差异决定了跨任务可用性。
en_tdlr: This paper separates understanding and generation directions in unified multimodal models by construction, revealing both channels are real but differ in kind: generation training installs match-only names, while understanding training installs producible names, which governs cross-task usability.
